//: ONE-SHOT seed job for QA/UAT. Reuses the API image because that is where the seed actually lives: prisma/seed.ts, the generated Prisma client, and ts-node (a devDependency the API Dockerfile deliberately keeps). A Railway Function or any bare runtime image cannot run this — it has no copy of the repository. THIS SERVICE EXISTS SO THE START COMMAND CAN BE OVERRIDDEN: a service with no config-as-code path falls back to the repository-root railway.json, which describes the API, so the seed service silently boots the API server instead (observed exactly that: 'ETicketsGo API listening on 0.0.0.0'). The compiler options are passed explicitly rather than using the package script, because the runtime image copies apps/api/prisma but NOT apps/api/tsconfig.json — ts-node then discovers some other tsconfig and dies with TS5109 (module NodeNext without a matching moduleResolution). Passing them inline makes the seed independent of whatever tsconfig happens to be reachable in the image. No healthcheckPath — a one-shot job serves nothing and would fail a health check. No preDeployCommand — migrations are the api service's job and must have exactly one executor. restartPolicyType NEVER is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: prisma/seed.ts calls reset() and deletes existing data first, so a restart loop would repeatedly wipe the environment. Run it deliberately, never on a schedule, and NEVER point it at production.
